data.name: Hum
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Hum was the name of the goddess of the earth, representing the primordial sound of the earth inhaling the breath of life. This name carries a sense of groundedness, connection to the earth, and the cycles of life.

in_hebrew.name: חומם

in_greek.name: Ὅμος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Ὅμος (Homos) is also derived from the term for 'dust' or 'humus'. This name shares the same meaning as its Hebrew counterpart, emphasizing the connection to the earth and the humble nature of the person bearing the name.

in_latin.name: Humus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Humus is a direct translation of the Hebrew and Greek names for 'dust' or 'humus'. This name holds the same significance, reminding us of the earthy origins and the humble nature of the person bearing the name.

in_english.name: Hum
